title: Talent selected for Shopify
intro: Prepared by Irvin Thevaranjan through the independent Ex-GH Talent Network. Four current directory profiles paired with Shopify openings reviewed October 19, 2026, plus a community introduction to Shopify Design. These are potential alignments; candidate interest, eligibility, and role-specific experience still need confirmation. Reply to Irvin to explore introductions.

items.note: Enterprise partner marketing, commerce, and monetization experience provide a relevant foundation. Explore joint positioning, co-marketing ownership, technology-platform partnerships, and measurable merchant adoption.
B2B engagement, product marketing, payments, and cross-functional GTM experience are relevant. Explore direct ownership of external partner programs, joint positioning, and co-marketing outcomes.

Built integrations, APIs, and platform products from zero to one and led a product team. Explore planning systems, roadmap dependencies, and cross-team delivery processes. Confirm interest in a senior individual-contributor Product Operations role.

Launched DaaS and Shop & Pay products across a complex marketplace. Explore ownership of planning processes, dependencies, and delivery systems across Product, Engineering, UX, and Data. Confirm interest in Product Operations rather than product-roadmap ownership.

Creative leadership and visual storytelling experience at Salesforce and gravitytank offer a relevant introduction to Shopify Design. This is a general design application, not a verified specific vacancy. Explore portfolio fit, hands-on AI tools, and technical prototyping; confirm interest and availability with Irvin.
